guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 访问 Imperial 并连接你的钱包
guide.description: 前往 Imperial 网站并连接你的 Solana 钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Visit Imperial and Connect Your Wallet
guide.original_description: Go to the Imperial website and connect your Solana wallet.

guide.title: 为你的子账户注入资金
guide.description: 将 USDC 存入你的 Imperial 子账户即可开始交易。如果你没有 USDC，你可以在 Binance 上购买它，或者使用下面的组件交换和跨链资金。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Deposit USDC into your Imperial subaccount to start trading. If you don’t have USDC, you can purchase it on Binance or swap and bridge funds using the widget below.

guide.title: 连接 Telegram 和 X 以获得奖金乘数
guide.description: 跨链资金无需离开此页面即可在 30+ 链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。立即跨链打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开跨链页面连接你的 Telegram 帐户并从仪表盘验证你的 X 帐户。每个连接都会授予 +0.50x 乘数，持续 7 天，并且两者都可以重新激活以保持奖金运行。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Telegram and X for Bonus Multipliers
guide.original_description: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Connect your Telegram account and verify your X account from the dashboard. Each connection grants a +0.50x multiplier for 7 days, and both can be reactivated to keep the bonus running.

guide.title: 交易永续合约赚取积分
guide.description: 在任何可用市场进行交易。积分每周根据你在合格交易活动总量中所占的份额进行分配。数量、支付的费用和你的活跃乘数都会影响你的每周分配。要建立每日和每周连续交易： 每日连续交易：每天交易量至少为 $100。每连续一天都会增加 +0.02x（30 天后上限为 +0.60x）。每周连续：每周交易量达到 $1,000 美元，连续每周可获得 +0.10x 奖金（6 周后上限为 +0.60x）。错过一天或一周会重置连续记录，因此一致性比数量峰值更重要。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Place trades across any available market. Points are distributed weekly based on your share of total qualified trading activity. Volume, fees paid, and your active multiplier all factor into your weekly allocation. To build daily and weekly streaks: Daily streak : Trade at least $100 in volume each day. Each consecutive day adds +0.02x (capped at +0.60x after 30 days). Weekly streak : Hit $1,000 in weekly volume for a +0.10x bonus per consecutive week (capped at +0.60x after 6 weeks). Missing a single day or week resets the streak, so consistency matters more than volume spikes.

guide.title: 达到个人等级
guide.description: 积分会累积到个人等级。较高级别的会员具有适用于所有未来每周收入的额外乘数： 自由人 (0 分)：无额外乘数平民 (100 分)：+0.05x 商人 (500 分)：+0.15x 马术 (2,500 分)： +0.20x 贵族 (10,000 分): +0.40x 参议员 (25,000 分): +0.65x 皇帝 (50,000 分): +1.00x 在一个时代结束时达到皇帝状态的用户可以重置回弗里曼以获得永久的“声望”状态。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Points accumulate toward individual rank tiers. Higher tiers carry extra multipliers that apply to all future weekly earnings: Freeman (0 pts): No extra multiplier Plebeian (100 pts): +0.05x Merchant (500 pts): +0.15x Equestrian (2,500 pts): +0.20x Patrician (10,000 pts): +0.40x Senator (25,000 pts): +0.65x Emperor (50,000 pts): +1.00x Users who reach Emperor status at the end of an era can reset back to Freeman for a permanent “prestige” status.

guide.original_description: Clans are invite-only groups that compete each week based on cumulative PnL. The top three clans each week earn bonus multipliers applied to every member for the following week: 1st place: +0.50x 2nd place: +0.30x 3rd place: +0.20x Enter an invite code on the Points dashboard to join a clan.

guide.title: 推荐交易者获得 USDC 奖励和奖励积分
guide.description: 在“奖励”页面上设置用户名并分享你的邀请链接。你可以从直接推荐中赚取 20% 费用，从第二级中赚取 10%，从第三级中赚取 5%，大约在 24 小时内即可领取。推荐也会增加你每周的总积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Refer Traders for USDC Rewards and Bonus Points
guide.original_description: Set a username on the Rewards page and share your referral link. You earn 20% of fees from direct referrals, 10% from second-tier, and 5% from third-tier, claimable in roughly 24 hours. Referrals also add to your weekly points total.
